/æl/, /əl/ Suffix Of or pertaining to. Adjectival suffix appended to various words, often nouns, to produce an adjective form. Often added to words of Latin origin, but used with other words also. Usage Note While words like formular , fibular , capsular , and bulbar follow the Latin norm, words like molal , phylal , salmonellal , and zooxanthellal do not.
